response.sql: SELECT t.observstation AS station, o.lunarstage AS moon_phase, AVG(t.bandusagepct) AS avg_bandwidth_usage_pct, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes t INNER JOIN observatories o ON t.observstation = o.observstation WHERE t.equipstatus IS NOT 'Maintenance' GROUP BY t.observstation, o.lunarstage ORDER BY telescope_count DESC LIMIT 10
